larson.parameters: min=8, max-exclusive=4096; 64 owner-local live objects/tasklet; 4*pool warmup replacements; 256 timed replacements/tasklet

selection: Chosen a priori from size/lifetime suitability, no application speedup guarantee; all declared configurations reported. Cloud trace sizes, operations and per-owner order preserved, allocation sizes are not rounded into the slab class by the workload.
cache_model: 64 entries/tasklet; 128 global warmup requests followed by 256 global measured requests; hash-sharded ownership; exact original sizes; full payload read/write checks; storage latency and interarrival time omitted.
